data.one_liner: A selector widget for different body parts.
data.what_it_does: Provides BodyPartSelector and BodyPartSelectorTurnable widgets to let users visually select different body parts. Supports interactive rotation and custom views.
use_when: You are building a health, fitness, or medical app where users need to select specific body parts.
You want a pre-built visual body part selection widget instead of building one from scratch.
avoid_when: You need non-human body part selections or custom anatomy charts not supported by the package.
You require a lightweight widget without external dependencies like flutter_svg and touchable.
strengths: Includes turnable/rotatable body part selection widgets.
Cross-platform support across mobile, web, and desktop.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples in the provided material.
Depends on multiple external packages like flutter_svg and touchable.
